## History

Alec was a good-tempered courtier and beau of [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), known for his lovely, curly black hair. While staying in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), he fetched [Janet](../character/janet.md) after John Douglas's mother passed away, allowing John to finally propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_
